item.title: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Tourism and Tourists
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites submissions exploring the applications, implications, and innovations of Large Language Models (LLMs) in the tourism industry and for enhancing tourist experiences. The rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence presents unprecedented opportunities and challenges for tourism stakeholders, from destination management organizations to hospitality providers to individual travelers.

Potential topics

  • Applications of LLMs in tourism management and operations
  • LLMs for personalized tourist experiences and recommendations
  • Natural language processing applications in tourism marketing
  • LLMs for tourism chatbots and customer service
  • Language translation and communication in tourism contexts
  • LLMs for travel planning and itinerary generation
  • Sentiment analysis and tourist feedback analysis using LLMs
  • LLMs for tourism research and data analysis

Timeline

  • August 31, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
